name: Not Reviewed
description: No documented decision or active review yet.

name: Draft
description: Working content is being prepared; not ready for approval.

name: In Review
description: Partially decided, qualified or awaiting remaining field approvals.

name: Approved
description: All required fields in the stated approval scope are approved.

name: Blocked
description: Cannot complete review until a dependency or missing specification is resolved.

name: Rejected
description: Reviewed proposal is explicitly not accepted.

name: Superseded
description: Replaced by a newer, explicitly linked canonical choice.
